title: Anomaly.Spells.List
description: Snapshot (module Anomaly.Spells): every spell the character KNOWS (learned, or given by class at its level), with id as the key, so a short name two classes share (blaz) is never ambiguous. Membership is durable: running out of mana, being confused, held or silenced does not remove a spell (those are in Char.Vitals and Char.Status). Sent on subscription, on request, and whenever any value in it changes: training, learning, and anything that moves the damage or heal band (level, gear, abilities, effects that change the spell damage bonus).

delivery.description: from the spell's Targets: 1 self, 2 self-or-ally, 8 single, 12 room, 13 party

element.description: AttType 0 cold, 1 fire, 2 stone, 3 lightning, 5 water, 6 poison; 4 (none) is null

damage.description: what one cast rolls before the target's resists, exactly as `spells` shows it (ParadigmSpellDamage.DamageBand): the level-scaled band, or the spell's fixed damage, lifted by this character's spell damage bonus (ability 165 plus the Spellcasting share). null for a spell that does no direct damage

heal.description: what one cast heals, as `spells` shows it (ParadigmSpellDamage.HealBand), with the bonus where the heal is scaled. null for a spell that does not heal
